description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'ReceiveShare' that handles shared data received from other apps. It processes the incoming intent to extract shared content such as text or URIs, displays information about the shared content, and forwards the data to a service when a button is clicked.

classes.name: ReceiveShare
classes.description: An Android Activity that handles sharing content, displays share info, and forwards data to a service.

methods.name: getShareUri
methods.description: Extracts the Uri from the incoming share intent, supporting multiple schemes (including ClipData).

methods.name: buildShareInfo
methods.description: Builds a textual representation of the shared content, handling text and URI data, including reading asset file descriptors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, processes shared data, and sets up a click listener to forward the share to a service.
